title: Safe Harbor Takes Miami Beach's Tides Hotel, Lands $44M Maxim Loan
summary: Safe Harbor Capital Partners secured a $44 million mortgage from Maxim Credit Group on the 45-room Tides Hotel at 1220 Ocean Drive and adjacent Collins Ave properties. It acquired the asset by credit bid at a March foreclosure auction against Chetrit Group, which is appealing a $95.6 million judgment. The renovated hotel is slated to reopen next month; the owner would consider a sale at the right price.

title: Baptist Health Buys Coral Gables Office Building for $39M, $321/SF
summary: Baptist Health South Florida bought 2855 Le Jeune Road from City National Bank for $39 million, about $321 per square foot, per records and Vizzda. The four-story 2007 building sits on 0.7 acres with a bank branch and 32,300 SF of offices. The bank sold after leasing 145,000 SF for its headquarters nearby. Health systems are competing for South Florida sites.

title: Dutch Corendon Pays $50M-Plus for Two South Beach Art Deco Hotels
summary: Corendon Hotels & Resorts made its first US hotel investment, paying over $50 million in one transaction for Aloha Friday's at 944 Collins Ave and the Beach Plaza Hotel at 1401 Collins Ave. The properties hold 97 and 95 rooms and are being rebranded. The seller paid $16.6M in 2024 and $26.5M in 2023. Berkadia's Jennifer Jin represented the seller, extending a trend of European buyers in Miami Beach hotels.

title: Chris Rokos Sells 2.8-Acre Manalapan Oceanfront Estate for $83.2M
summary: British hedge fund manager Chris Rokos sold his Manalapan estate at 1370 South Ocean Boulevard for $83.2 million to BigOcean 3M LLC, a Delaware entity acting for a land trust. The 2.8-acre property has a 29,500 SF house and 300 feet of ocean frontage. A UK-registered entity paid $40 million in 2017. Bank of America provided the buyer a $58.2 million mortgage.

title: Freddie Mac: 30-Year Mortgage Rate Jumps 12 bps to 7.40%
summary: Freddie Mac's Primary Mortgage Market Survey put the 30-year fixed-rate average at 7.40% as of October 8, 2026, up from 7.28% the prior week, a 12 basis-point increase. Mortgage News Daily's index showed 7.52% for the 30-year fixed and 7.65% for the jumbo on Oct. 9, which matters for financing on South Florida luxury purchases.

title: Foreclosure Suit Targets Pembroke Lakes Mall Over $260M Loan Default
summary: Deutsche Bank sued over the $260 million, 2013-issued loan on the 748,800 SF Pembroke Lakes Mall in Pembroke Pines, which was not repaid at its March maturity and went to special servicing. The mall was appraised at $427 million in 2013 and $112 million as of April. It is 96% occupied; first-half NOI was $8.3 million against $3.9 million of debt service, but the 3.6% loan rate makes refinancing difficult.

title: Terra's David Martin, Partners Close $507M Loan for 28-Story South Beach Condo Tower
summary: Terra and partners RG Development, GV Development and Lore Development closed a $507 million construction loan from Tyko Capital for a 28-story, 106-unit condo tower at 1250 West Avenue, Miami Beach. The loan came earlier in the development process than is typical in South Florida; sales are expected to launch next year. JDS Development transferred the site to Terra last year, and the approved overlay allows a 330-foot building.

title: Missouri Developer Pays $32M, $10,460/SF, for Sunset Islands Waterfront Home
summary: An entity linked to developer Victor Alston paid $32 million for a 3,060 SF waterfront home at 1601 North View Drive, Sunset Islands, Miami Beach, on a 0.6-acre lot, with a $23 million Fryd Mortgage loan. The 1950-built house last sold for $21 million in 2024. Also Oct. 6: an $11.4 million Homestead lot sale at $200/SF and an $8 million North Miami industrial sale at $377/SF.

title: Blackstone's Link Logistics Sells Fort Lauderdale Industrial Park for $57M
summary: Link Logistics, Blackstone's industrial arm, sold the 210,000 SF industrial and business park at 2201-2385 Stirling Road, Fort Lauderdale, to BKM Capital Partners and Kayne Anderson Real Estate for $57 million, about $271 per SF. The seven-building, 18-unit property is 97% occupied and is being rebranded Stirling Landing. Cushman & Wakefield's Rick Brugge represented the seller.

title: Batmasian Buys Boca Raton Office Complex for $38.2M, About $319/SF
summary: James Batmasian's Investments Limited bought two office buildings (119,800 SF, built 1968 and 2004) and a 130,000 SF parking garage on 2.2 acres at 555-595 South Federal Highway, Boca Raton. The seller, a Pinnacle Holdings entity, paid $33.2 million in 2014 and $36.7 million was paid in 2005. Tenants include Morgan Stanley, EverBank and Old Republic Title. He also paid $4.5 million for a 4,000 SF office building nearby.

title: Mystery Buyer Assembles $311M, 18.5-Acre Gulf-Front Compound in Naples' Port Royal
summary: A secret land trust that paid $225 million last year for three Gordon Drive properties, the largest residential sale in Florida history, bought neighboring 2100 Gordon Drive (3.4 acres) for $86 million in an off-market June deal. Together about 18.5 acres of Gulf frontage are in one hand. 2340 Gordon Drive later traded to a related trust at $84 million, up from $46.9 million. Demolition permits have been sought and new-construction applications are under review.

title: Mandarin Oriental Miami Has Sold $1.7B of Condos Before Groundbreaking
summary: Swire Properties' Residences at Mandarin Oriental on Brickell Key has booked $1.7 billion in pre-construction sales; its 66-floor south tower of 228 residences is 80% sold and the 33-floor north tower, with a 121-room hotel, is 25% sold. Buyers are 65% domestic and many pay all cash. Prices are up 30% since 2024 sales began; groundbreaking is this month, with completion projected for 2030.

title: SharkNinja Founder Sells Palm Island Mansion for $60.9M, $4,700 Per SF
summary: An entity tied to SharkNinja founder Mark Rosenzweig sold the 13,000 SF waterfront house at 73 Palm Avenue for $60.9 million to a trust named for the address; it last traded in 2019 at $24.6 million. Other Oct. 2 deals: a $24.1 million Morningside flip (bought for $16 million last year), a $19.8 million Hibiscus Island home, and a $17 million Fisher Island condo at about $4,000 per SF.

title: Lenders Deal Out $436M for South Florida Projects, Led by JSB's $238M Doral Refi
summary: JSB Capital refinanced the 631-unit Landmark South in Doral with a $238 million floating-rate, interest-only bridge loan from Torchlight Investors, about $377,000 per unit; Walker & Dunlop arranged it. Fuse Group and KREA Developments got a $127 million Madison Realty Capital loan on the 502-unit Arcadian in Fort Lauderdale ($253,000 per unit). Lenders describe a conservative market where mid-market deals are harder to place than large ones.

title: Monarch and Tourmaline Seek $400M-Plus for Brickell's 801 Brickell Office Tower
summary: The owners hired Eastdil Secured to sell the 28-story, 437,000 SF tower at about $900 per SF, which would be a Brickell office record; they paid Nuveen $250 million in 2023, Florida's priciest office sale that year. In-place rents run about 40% below Brickell asking rates, which averaged $90.25 per SF this summer per Savills, giving a buyer mark-to-market upside.

title: Larry Ellison Lists North Palm Beach Estate for a Record $165M, Double His 2021 Price
summary: The Oracle founder is asking $165 million for his 8.4-acre Seminole Landing compound at 12210 Banyan Road, which he bought for $80 million in 2021 and first listed at $145 million in 2022. The 16,300 SF, seven-bedroom 1991 house has more than 550 feet of water frontage; the ask is a North Palm Beach record at over $10,000 per SF, or $19.6 million per acre. K2 Realty's Paul Kaneb and James Kenny have the listing.
